scope: Repair and local reproduction of a Kaggle-specific installer test-fixture failure. No full Kaggle GPU completion claim.
reproduced_inner_error: Installed runtime failed its integrity check and was not selected for use.
root_cause: The synthetic installer test inherited LAB2_ENV_DIR from Kaggle while its mocked health predicate only accepted paths containing .lab2-envs. A valid external environment location therefore caused the fixture, not actual model training, to fail.
repair: Isolate installer unit-test environment overrides from the live runtime, restore the inherited values afterward, and add a regression asserting that real external cache paths remain untouched.

legacy_bundle_recovery_cell.skip_reason: The uploaded-notebook artifact test is intentionally external to its embedded runtime source bundle.
legacy_bundle_recovery_cell.recovery: Only the unit-test subprocesses omit LAB2_ENV_DIR and LAB2_BOOTSTRAP_DIR. No package reinstall or runtime restart is required in the existing connected session.
